pins.name: VBUS detect
pins.notes: Detects whether USB or external power is connected. High level means external power is present.

pins.name: Battery voltage sample
pins.notes: Reads battery voltage through an internal 50 percent / 50 percent resistor divider.

pins.name: E-paper DC
pins.notes: Selects command or data for SPI transfers.

notes: The e-paper display uses SPI and does not use MISO.
For custom ESP-IDF firmware, use Pure USB Serial/JTAG console output. The default UART console pins may conflict with GPIO20; disable ESP_CONSOLE_UART_DEFAULT and enable ESP_CONSOLE_USB_SERIAL_JTAG.
Wi-Fi, Bluetooth LE, and the internal temperature sensor do not require external GPIOs.
